title: Building an AI App — Connect Input to a Checked Output
key_insight: Separate the interface, orchestration, model adapter, and storage boundaries. Typed data between them makes failures visible.
body:
## Connect Input to a Checked Output

A working prototype needs more than one prompt. It must gather context, call the model, validate output, and present a useful next action.

Separate the interface, orchestration, model adapter, and storage boundaries. Typed data between them makes failures visible.

Log consent-safe events and user corrections. Feedback is valuable only when tied to the exact model, prompt, and context.
common_mistakes: Adding a chat box automatically creates user value.
Fluent output proves the user task succeeded.
A production app needs no fallback path.
mini_exercise: Draw “Connect Input to a Checked Output” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: A useful AI app connects a clear user job to context, model calls, validation, feedback, and fallback behavior.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Connect Input to a Checked Output” to explain Building an AI App plainly.
